races.title: State House, District 85
races.note: Write-in candidates aren't printed on the ballot: you'd write their name on the blank line.

cands.name: Wayne Richter
cands.bio: Democrat, first-time candidate. Criminal defense attorney, founding partner of the Law Offices of R. Wayne Richter, P.A. (15+ years); Treasurer of the Florida Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers; past president of the Martin County Bar Association.
cands.local_ties: Lives in Palm City with his wife Katie and three children (Florida Politics).

record.text: No prior elected office. Priorities: lower energy, grocery, housing and insurance costs; public schools; water quality; restoring local zoning authority.

money_notes.text: Raised over $82,000 in his first month (mostly legal profession donors plus a $4,000 self-loan); also uses the political committee Restore Our Community.

cands.gaps: Endorsements not found. Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.

cands.name: Anthony Bonna
cands.bio: Republican, open seat (Toby Overdorf term-limited). Port St. Lucie City Council member (District 3, elected 2021); appointed to St. Lucie County Commission by Gov. Rick Scott in 2018; Realtor and marketing professional; Georgetown finance degree.
cands.local_ties: Port St. Lucie council member since 2021; St. Lucie County Commission 2018 (Florida Politics).

record.text: Appointed to the St. Lucie County Commission in March 2018; elected to Port St. Lucie council in 2021. Previously campaign manager for Sen. Gayle Harrell and researcher for Rick Scott's 2010 campaign.

money_notes.text: Early fundraising ran through his campaign and the political committee Treasure Coast Leadership Fund; about $175,000 raised through Dec. 31, 2025.

endorsements.text: Outgoing Rep. Toby Overdorf; Associated Industries of Florida; Florida Realtors; Florida Chamber; St. Lucie Sheriff Richard Del Toro and the other four Port St. Lucie council members (at launch).

cands.gaps: Controversies not searched beyond coverage above. Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.

cands.name: Amr Metwally
cands.bio: Listed on the ballot under party code MGT (his site calls him an 'MGTOW' candidate). Owns Egyptian Shawarma and Metwally Web Services; founder of MGTOW.TV. Says he first filed for U.S. House District 6 but did not raise enough to qualify.
cands.local_ties: Says he was raised in House District 85 (his website); DOE filing county Martin.

record.text: His website describes himself as 'Anti Zionist' and states that the 'Zionist Controlled government' is illegitimate and that Republicans and Democrats must be expelled from office. These are his own stated positions, unchecked.
BallotReady lists policy positions including abolishing the Federal Reserve and returning to the gold standard.
